name: Cutout tales
description: Code-drawn 2D cutout / puppet storytelling: flat vector characters that barely move, layered parallax sets and pop-in overlays, timed to the voiceover.

instructions.image: Flat vector adult cutout characters (about 7 heads tall, mitten hands, dark-brown outline, one hard shadow tone), layered sets with parallax depth, dust and vignette.
instructions.motion: Characters barely move (breathing, blinks, slow sway); a slow camera push-in plus drift and back-out pop-in overlays carry the energy. Shots are cut to voiceover sentences.
instructions.composition: The planner outputs only a JSON shot list (set, mood, cast archetypes, poses, overlays); the renderer lays overlays out so they never overlap each other or a head. Keep one style for the whole film.
instructions.negative: No game, film or TV characters. No model-written drawing code. No unseeded randomness, render-time network or live clocks.
acceptance: Identical pixels after repeated and backward seeking
Overlays never overlap each other or a head, in 16:9 and 9:16
Readable copy in landscape and portrait
